**D.** The federal court will retain the entire case because the federal age and sex discrimination claims make it removable under 28 U.S.C. § 1441(a), the removal was timely under § 1446(b), and the state claims fall within supplemental jurisdiction under § 1367(a). The attorney's motive and the judge's hostility are irrelevant to jurisdiction, so C gives the wrong reason even though it reaches the same outcome.

CONFIDENCE: 75
